#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool possible(int m, int w) {
    if (m <= 0) {
        return true;
    }
    int remainder = m % w;
    if (remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1) {
        return false;
    }
    return possible((m + 1) / w, w);
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    if (w < 4) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << (possible(m, w) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
